statement.zh-TW: 河岸麵包坊這個月推出麵包禮券，一共賣出 {{money:vars.sold}}，到月底只有 {{money:vars.redeemed}} 的禮券被拿來換麵包。這個月的損益表可以認列 {{money:vars.sold}} 的營業收入。
statement.en: This month Riverside Bakery launched bread vouchers and sold {{money:vars.sold}} of them; by month end only {{money:vars.redeemed}} worth had been exchanged for bread. This month’s income statement can recognise {{money:vars.sold}} of revenue.

feedbackTrue.zh-TW: 錢確實全部收到了，這點沒錯。但收入要在客人拿到麵包時才算賺到：這個月賺到的只有已兌換的 {{money:vars.redeemed}}，還沒兌換的禮券是麵包坊欠客人的，要記成預收收入。
feedbackTrue.en: All the money has indeed been received, that much is right. But revenue is earned only when the customer gets the bread: this month’s revenue is just the {{money:vars.redeemed}} redeemed, and the unredeemed vouchers are what the bakery owes its customers, recorded as contract liabilities.

feedbackFalse.zh-TW: 答對了。這個月能認列的營業收入是已兌換的 {{money:vars.redeemed}}；其餘的禮券等客人來換麵包時，才一張一張變成收入。
feedbackFalse.en: That’s right. This month’s revenue is the {{money:vars.redeemed}} already redeemed; the rest of the vouchers become revenue one by one as customers exchange them for bread.

explanation.zh-TW: 權責發生制看的是麵包交出去了沒，不是錢收到了沒。賒銷是「賺到但沒收到」，預售禮券則是「收到但還沒賺到」，兩種情況現金和收入都不同步。
explanation.en: The accrual basis asks whether the bread has been handed over, not whether the cash has arrived. A credit sale is ‘earned but not received’; a pre-sold voucher is ‘received but not yet earned’. In both cases cash and revenue are out of step.
